name: vllm-rocm-halo-main
description: vLLM upstream main runtime for AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151), ASSEMBLED from the prebuilt wheel pkg (vllm-wheel-halo) onto the InferStation pytorch-rocm-halo v2-staging base + transformers 5.10.2 (full multimodal). Rebuild the wheel pkg (vllm-rocm-halo-main-wheel) first when bumping vLLM or the base image. Legacy one-shot compile-in-place Dockerfile kept at Dockerfile.legacy.
